name: Apple Juice
siboNotes: Apple juice is very high in excess fructose and should be avoided during SIBO treatment phases. Even small amounts can trigger symptoms.
preparationTips: Dilute with water if you must consume, but better to avoid entirely
Check labels for added high fructose corn syrup which increases FODMAP load
Fresh-pressed varieties may be slightly lower in FODMAPs than concentrated
Consider having with a meal rather than on empty stomach if consuming
alternatives: Lemon or lime water with stevia
nutritionalHighlights: High in natural sugars and calories
